qualification.en: The line is about the country’s role in global climate action. It does not say whether national energy policy should put moving away from coal, oil and gas first, and the same document also cites record domestic oil and gas production. It is shown and not scored.

quote: As Democrats, we believe the United States has an indispensable role to play in solving the climate crisis, and we have an obligation to help other nations carry out this work.

sourceTitle.en: 2024 Democratic Party Platform (PDF, undated; text published by the DNC in its press release of August 18, 2024, for a delegate vote the next day), p. 38

summary.en: The platform says Democrats believe the United States has an indispensable role in solving the climate crisis and an obligation to help other nations with that work.
